blocks.content: Revisiting Recreate from the strategy-comparison lens this module takes, its core tradeoff is the direct mirror image of rolling update's: no version overlap at all, at the cost of real, deliberate downtime.

The actual behavior, terminating every old Pod before starting any new ones, is covered in the Deployments module's Deployment Strategy topic, this topic focuses on when and why you would genuinely choose it.

blocks.alt: The mechanics live in the Deployments module, this topic covers when to actually choose it

blocks.content: 2. The Real Advantage: Zero Version Overlap
blocks.text: 2. The Real Advantage: Zero Version Overlap

blocks.content: This is Recreate's genuine strength, and the exact thing rolling update cannot offer, at no point do old and new versions ever run at the same time, a real, meaningful guarantee for changes where that overlap would be actively dangerous.

blocks.alt: A genuine guarantee rolling update simply cannot offer, no overlap, ever

blocks.content: This is the direct, unavoidable price, there is a real window where nothing is serving traffic at all, exactly the tradeoff rolling update exists specifically to avoid.

blocks.alt: A real, deliberate cost, not a side effect, the whole reason rolling update exists instead

blocks.content: 4. When It Is Genuinely the Right Call
blocks.text: 4. When It Is Genuinely the Right Call

blocks.content: A backward-incompatible database migration, one where the old application code would genuinely corrupt data or crash against the new schema, is a legitimate case where accepting brief downtime is safer than the overlap a rolling update would otherwise introduce.

blocks.alt: A genuinely legitimate case, not a fallback chosen out of laziness

blocks.content: Recreate and rolling update are, quite literally, opposite tradeoffs on the exact same axis, no overlap but real downtime, versus real overlap but no downtime, choosing between them means deciding honestly which risk your specific change can actually tolerate.

blocks.alt: Two opposite answers to the exact same underlying tradeoff

blocks.title: Key Takeaway
points: Recreate guarantees zero version overlap, old and new never coexist, at the direct cost of real, deliberate downtime, the exact opposite tradeoff from rolling update.
It is the right, deliberate choice specifically when a backward-incompatible change makes any version overlap genuinely dangerous, not a default to reach for casually.
